project.name: property-analyst-pro
project.description: Real estate investment analyzer. Streamlit application that ingests Zillow ZHVI data, extracts features, trains a RandomForest model, and serves pre-computed metro-level appreciation predictions. Quarterly forward-validation protocol with conservative projection logic and sanity caps.

principles.text: Accuracy of financial calculations is non-negotiable. Every numerical output must be verifiably correct. The financial calculation engine, hardcoded sanity caps, and conservative projection logic are sacred — no modification without explicit owner approval.
All user-facing data must cite its source. Every prediction, metric, or statistic displayed in the app must be traceable to a named data source and vintage.
Keep the UI simple. Users care about accurate, trustworthy results delivered through a clean experience. Do not add UI complexity unless it directly serves accuracy or trust.

protected_patterns.description: Hardcoded appreciation sanity caps: -10% to +15%. Constitutional. Owner approval required to modify.
Conservative multi-year projection logic: 7% annual cap, negative floor. Constitutional. Owner approval required to modify.
Hardcoded price bounds: $170,000 to $1,000,000. Constitutional. Owner approval required to modify.
Model performance thresholds: MAPE <= 3.5%, R² >= 0.98. Used to gate quarterly retraining. Owner approval required to modify.

module_map.app.py: Streamlit entry point and UI layer
module_map.predictor.py: Prediction serving — loads pre-computed CSV predictions and exposes them to the app
module_map.zillow_filter.py: Data filtering and preprocessing of raw ZHVI data per metros.yaml config
module_map.process_data.py: Full data processing pipeline: raw ZHVI → features → predictions CSV
module_map.ml/: Model training, feature extraction, forward-validation logic
module_map.data/raw/: Raw Zillow ZHVI data files (quarterly drops)
module_map.data/processed/: Pre-computed predictions and processed feature CSVs
module_map.metros.yaml: Configuration: target metro areas and parameters
module_map.notebooks/: Canonical notebook for feature extraction, model training, and analysis

audience.codebase: Optimized for agent consumption first. Bare minimum human readability for owner audit and manual editing. Not user-facing.
audience.application: End users interact only with the Streamlit app. They expect good UX, accurate results, and trustworthy data.
